be4d5ceb60.en: A softball diamond in Montana was the scene of a larger-than-life family reunion. Like something out of Field of Dreams, a teen softball player had lined up against an out-of-state team for an August match—and her long-lost biological sister was on the opposite roster. Samantha Rensvold was adopted as an infant. Rensvold had not seen the opposing player—18-year-old Kyann Dean—whom a teammate came over to explain looked exactly like her.

beb21be0b4.en: West Indies won the fourth T20I at the Uppal Rajiv Gandhi International Stadium in Hyderabad by an impressive margin. The Caribbean team defeated India by 24 runs in this fierce battle that took place as part of the five-match series. The win tied the series at 2-2. Batting first, the West Indies scored a huge score of 247 runs for the loss of three wickets in the allotted twenty overs.

summary-story-no-pairs.en: A newly installed solar microgrid ensures uninterrupted electricity for medical operations. Essential vaccines and diagnostic machines now stay powered through both day and night.
summary-story-no-pairs.te: కొత్తగా ఏర్పాటు చేసిన సోలార్ మైక్రోగ్రిడ్ వైద్య కార్యకలాపాలకు అంతరాయం లేని విద్యుత్‌ను అందిస్తుంది. ముఖ్యమైన టీకాలు మరియు పరికరాలు రాత్రింబవళ్లు పనిచేస్తాయి.
